title: Rooftop Signal Reveal
intent: A lone radio operator reaches a rain-soaked rooftop antenna as the camera cranes up to reveal an enormous blackout across the city.

world.lighting: Storm-blue ambient sky, one pulsing red aviation beacon, distant lightning, and reflected rain on tar roofing.

objects.role: exhausted radio operator in a dark waterproof coat approaching the antenna
weathered rooftop radio mast with cables and a blinking red beacon
small concrete rooftop utility room behind the operator
dark neighboring office tower establishing the blackout scale
unlit mid-distance residential tower creating a second depth layer beyond the neighboring office
very distant dark high-rise silhouette establishing the outer scale of the citywide blackout

camera.rig: slow stabilized crane rising from an intimate medium follow into a wide city reveal

seedance.style: Large-format disaster drama with realistic rain, deep city scale, subdued cyan-gray color, precise red beacon accents, and a patient escalating reveal.
continuity: one continuous crane shot with no cut
the operator stops beside the same antenna mast
the city remains almost entirely dark except emergency lights
rain direction and coat wetness remain consistent
the neighboring, mid-distance, and far towers remain distinct depth layers throughout the final reveal
